ns2:section.sectionText: This section is a placeholder, and cannot be registered. This course is for Statistics doctoral students for thesis-related research. To register, please email stat-registration@illinois.edu (copying your advisor as well) with your name and UIN, and you will be provided with the CRN to add. Registering for this course without instructor approval can result in a failing grade. For general Statistics course registration information: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration
